title: Realm Beyond the Veil
description: A cinematic fantasy short exploring mystical characters and enchanted places beyond the human world

scenes.description: A floating fantasy island above glowing clouds at dawn
scenes.visual_prompt: Massive floating fantasy island above glowing clouds at dawn, ancient stone ruins covered in moss, waterfalls flowing into the sky, soft golden sunrise light, slow forward camera dolly, gentle cloud movement, subtle parallax depth, cinematic fantasy atmosphere, ultra realistic
scenes.negative_prompt: people talking, mouth movement, text, watermark, cartoon, anime
scenes.motion_hint: slow forward dolly, clouds drifting upward, waterfalls flowing
scenes.narration: Beyond the skies we know, there exists a realm untouched by time. A world suspended above the clouds, where ancient stones remember forgotten ages, and waterfalls fall endlessly into the open sky.
scenes.subtitle: A realm beyond the skies ☁️✨
